title: Agentic AI on AWS Bootcamp
description: Build AI agents on AWS with Strands, Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore, from a first agent to a team running in production, plus live finance and travel projects.
verticalDescription: Applied AI engineering: LLM apps, RAG, agents on AWS, evaluation and shipping AI systems to production.

modules.title: Bootcamp Overview
modules.description: Learn to build AI agents on AWS: start with one Strands agent on Amazon Bedrock and end with a team of agents running in production, then use them on real finance problems. Each week has its recordings, lessons and solution code.
